title: 영역 믹스 솔로 #115 · 블루블랙·검정 배경 고정 매체 믹스 · 부채꼴·매끈 · 4영역(이레즈미+UV 네온+옵아트 체커보드+사이아노타입) · wide hip narrow · 와이드 스탠스·주먹 힙 · 블루블랙 · 배경 검정 스튜디오 · 메이크업 없음(블루블랙)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 20s goddess, wide hip narrow physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — hips so impossibly wide extending beyond frame creating the most extreme hip-to-waist ratio ever, waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, upper body slim emphasizing the dramatic hip explosion, blunt collarbone-length bob thick heavy — her body is painted in 4 different painting styles at once, each style claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 60% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 4 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 12 o'clock, 2 o'clock, 5 o'clock and 9 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. Region 1 is the wedge between the 12 o'clock ray and the 2 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries traditional Japanese irezumi tattoo art in bold black ink outlines with indigo, crimson and white waves, clouds and peonies flowing over her curves. Region 2 is the wedge between the 2 o'clock ray and the 5 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries fluorescent UV neon paint in neon pink and acid lime lightning streaks, glowing intensely with a blacklight shimmer. Region 3 is the wedge between the 5 o'clock ray and the 9 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries black-and-white op-art checkerboard distorted into a bulging optical illusion. Region 4 is the wedge between the 9 o'clock ray and the 12 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries deep Prussian-blue cyanotype prints with white fern and leaf silhouettes. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring paintings blend along the edge: brushwork of one reaches into the other and the two styles simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring paintings, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course, every painting laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living blue-black skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: full frontal wide stance, both fists pressing outer hips outward to absolute maximum, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme wide hip narrow silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform stiletto heels of real glossy patent leather, each in a main colour of whichever painting that leg falls in, and extra long nails each polished in a main colour of whichever painting that hand falls in.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every brush stroke and every blended transition. Pattern density MAXIMUM — every inch from neck to ankle filled with painting. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
